title: SeaRates Attends Transport Logistic 2025 Munich
meta_description: SeaRates joins Transport Logistic 2025 Munich from June 2-5. Meet Lilia Khovrak and Alexander Grabarchuk to discuss global freight management technology.
body:
Trade fair halls in Munich tend to fill quickly once June arrives. Announced May 30, 2025, SeaRates team members Lilia Khovrak and Alexander Grabarchuk will represent the team at Transport Logistic 2025 Munich at Trade Fair Center Messe München from June 2 to 5, 2025. They plan to connect with cargo owners and partners regarding practical uses of global freight management technology.

The conference agenda covers practical priorities across several tracks. Sessions focus on digital supply chain security and protection methods for freight data, alongside applications of logistics AI for SMEs trying to streamline operations. Air freight sustainability measures and international trade strategies, including Singapore's role as a reliable partner, are also scheduled for discussion. In addition, panels will address chemical logistics standardization and digital harmonization in pharmaceutical supply chains.

Exhibition areas this year are structured around specific focus groups. Hall B1 features the Young Innovators section for startups and innovative IT or e-commerce companies. Hall A3 houses Campus Plaza, where research institutes display current logistics R&D. National pavilions across the venue showcase logistics capabilities of different countries.

Meetings with Lilia Khovrak and Alexander Grabarchuk can be scheduled prior to the event by contacting sales@searates.com or connecting through LinkedIn.
